description: This PHP class defines the 'I18NError' entity used in the OrangeHRM system for handling internationalization error types. It includes constants representing different error categories, properties for 'name' and 'message', and corresponding getter and setter methods. The class is mapped to the 'ohrm_i18n_error' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: I18NError
classes.description: Entity class representing different internationalization error types for the system; mapped to the 'ohrm_i18n_error' database table.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the error type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the error type.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message associated with the error.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message associated with the error.
